02 · What’s changing

What’s changing

Work is assigned by market and capacity instead of team by team. These changes apply to Shared Services team members.

The biggest change

Marketing tasks move out of Shared Services to Marketing. That frees up time for Shared Services to take on more broker teams.

Shared Services

Transactions, listings and administration

Handles transactions, listings and administration for broker teams, working from one shared queue.

Dedicated Client Services

Same broker teams

Stays with its own broker teams and is also responsible for non-creative marketing tasks, like producing packages from approved templates.

03 · The work

The work, by group

What Shared Services and Dedicated Client Services handle for your teams.

Shared Services Dedicated Client Services

Transactions and administration

71 transaction tasks and 25 administrative tasks

Deals and critical dates

Critical dates memos and tracking, contingencies, listing agreements, LOIs, CAs, offer matrices and offer booklets

Due diligence and closing

DD documents, tours, third-party reports, site inspections, attorneys, title, escrow, wires, invoices and lien waivers

Commissions and expenses

Deal sheets, commission booking statements, broker splits, co-broke paperwork, expense reports in Ramp

Frankie and data

Properties, people and companies, owner links, activities, deal notes, ownership updates, IntellCRE sync

Pipeline and reporting

Pipeline in Frankie and ClickUp, PowerBI listing and revenue reports, weekly team pipeline meetings

Leads and listing status

Leads from CoStar, Crexi, Revere and Frankie; Sold status on every platform; bounces and unsubscribes

Documents and records

SharePoint and RCM folders, DocuSign, FARBAR drafts, flood zone checks, BOR checks, closing submissions

Team and client admin

Signage, event registration and invites, client lunches, shared calendar, training others

Coming soon

FLOW

FLOW is the new Shared Services platform. It brings every request and deal into one shared place, so any team member can pick up where another left off.

  • Connected to PIXELFLOW is interconnected with PIXEL, so creating tickets is quicker and easier.
  • Email and text intakeRequests sent by email or text become tickets automatically.
  • Daily deal checkAI reviews each active deal and drafts follow-ups for a person to approve.
  • Shared inbox and coverageDeal emails, notes and handoffs in one place, so coverage is seamless.
  • Broker status pageA private link and email or text updates show where each request stands.
  • ReportsVolume and turnaround tracked for every request.
